content: To train n-gram language models that are robust to various domains and, we collect corpus from many resources, mainly is come from newspaper site (like dantri, vnexpress,..), law document and some crawled repository. In total, more than 50GB of text split to separate subjects was used to train n-gram language models. Table TABREF10 shows the statistic of the collected data.
